items.content: Can you remind me to call Teodor at Brightline before Friday? He still hasn't sent the revised quote for knocking out the pantry wall.
items.query: What document was Teodor late in delivering?

items.content: The main water shutoff valve is in the basement crawlspace behind the furnace, painted red.
items.query: If a pipe bursts, where do I go to stop everything flowing into the house?

items.content: Priya prefers Halden-gray grout over white for the upstairs bathroom tile, since white shows every stain.
items.query: What's the reasoning behind going with Halden-gray?

items.content: Kitchen remodel recap as of March 14, 2026: cabinets ordered with an eight-week lead time, electrician finished rough-in, and the countertop template is scheduled once the base units are installed. Spent so far is $31,200 of the $48,000 budget.
items.query: Where do things stand overall on redoing the cooking area, including how much money is gone?

items.content: On April 3, 2026 the city inspector signed off on the framing for permit BP-26-04417 but flagged a missing fire block near the chimney chase.
items.query: What problem came up during the BP-26-04417 walkthrough?

items.content: I've added Juniper's swim lessons to the family calendar: Tuesdays and Thursdays at 4:30 at the Westbrook aquatic center, starting June 9.
items.query: When does our daughter go to the pool for classes?

items.content: The dishwasher is a Klarsen DW-7740; the warranty runs through November 2027 and the appliance registration card is taped inside the junk drawer.
items.query: Until when is the DW-7740 covered?

items.content: Daniel doesn't want any contractor working inside the house before 8 a.m. on weekdays because he takes calls from home early.
items.query: What's the soonest hour my partner is okay with builders showing up?

items.content: Contractor bids for the deck rebuild: Pinecrest Carpentry quoted $14,800 with composite boards, Sutter & Gale quoted $12,300 in cedar, and Hollis Brothers never returned the measurements. We're leaning toward Sutter & Gale.
items.query: How much did Pinecrest want for the job?

items.content: Oskar broke his left wrist at the trampoline park on February 21, 2026 and wore a cast for six weeks.
items.query: What injury did our son get at the jumping venue, and when?

items.content: The upstairs toilet keeps running after every flush again — I think the flapper is shot. Can you find a plumber who can come Saturday?
items.query: Which bathroom fixture was I complaining won't stop filling?

items.content: Our property tax parcel ID is 0817-QM-332, and the assessment appeal deadline each year is May 31.
items.query: When is the cutoff to contest the valuation on 0817-QM-332?

items.content: Priya wants low-VOC paint in the kids' bedrooms, even if it costs more, because Juniper gets headaches from fumes.
items.query: Which household member's sensitivity is driving the choice of finish for the children's sleeping spaces?

items.content: Week of May 18 logistics: Oskar has the Quarryhill soccer tournament Saturday, Juniper's piano recital is Sunday at 2, and the Brightline crew is off Monday for Memorial Day.
items.query: On which day is the Quarryhill competition?

items.content: The refrigerator's ice maker leaked overnight on January 12, 2026 and warped two oak floorboards; the insurance adjuster came out on January 15.
items.query: Which appliance mishap ruined some planks of the hardwood?

items.content: I checked the county portal: the electrical permit for the garage subpanel was issued under reference EL-5529, and it expires 180 days after issue if no inspection is requested.
items.query: How long before EL-5529 lapses if nobody books a walkthrough?

items.content: Juniper is allergic to tree nuts, so her school lunches and any party snacks need to be checked for almonds and cashews.
items.query: What food sensitivity does our daughter have?

items.content: For the new range hood, Daniel insists on venting it outside rather than a recirculating model, and he likes the Vellmar 600 CFM unit.
items.query: What's the airflow capacity of the Vellmar under consideration?

items.content: Insurance and warranty roundup: homeowner's policy renews September 1 with Fernbrook Mutual, the roof's workmanship warranty from Calder Roofing ends in 2031, and the water heater was replaced under warranty in 2025.
items.query: What protection plans do we have on the property, and what are their key dates?

items.content: On June 27, 2026 the Brightline crew found knob-and-tube wiring behind the dining room plaster, which added a $3,450 change order.
items.query: What did uncovering the knob-and-tube cost us?

items.content: Plots 14 through 22 sit on old parking-lot fill, and the soil test showed lead at 410 ppm, so only lined raised beds are allowed there.
items.query: Which part of the garden does the 410 reading concern?

items.content: Has anyone got the key to the tool shed? The combination lock was swapped and I couldn't get the wheelbarrow out on Sunday morning.
items.query: What problem did a gardener hit with the equipment hut after its latch was replaced?

items.content: The steering committee prefers that compost from the Vermillion bins go to the shared herb spiral first, before individual plots can claim any.
items.query: Who gets priority on the Vermillion output?

items.content: On August 16, 2026 the cooperative donated 212 pounds of tomatoes and zucchini to the Eastgate food pantry.
items.query: How much produce did we give away to the hunger charity, and when?

items.content: Recap of the late-summer workday: 23 volunteers turned beds, Marisol Achterberg rebuilt the drip line on the north row, the rain barrels were cleaned, and new woodchips went down on the paths.
items.query: What did Achterberg repair that day?

items.content: Annual plot fees are $45 for a full bed and $25 for a half bed, due by March 1, and members on SNAP can request a waiver.
items.query: How much does it cost each year to rent growing space, and is there help for low-income gardeners?

items.content: Reminder for everyone: the city water hookup at the Larkspur gate gets shut off October 31 for winter, so drain your hoses before then.
items.query: When does the spigot at Larkspur go dry for the season?

items.content: Most members want the garden kept pesticide-free, allowing only hand-picking and neem oil for pest control.
items.query: What's the group's stance on spraying chemicals to deal with bugs?

items.content: A groundhog tunneled under the east fence on July 9, 2026 and wiped out the bean row in plots 3 and 4; Tobiah Renquist set a live trap the next evening.
items.query: What did Renquist do about the critter?

items.content: Fall closing checklist: pull spent plants by October 25, leave perennials in place, return borrowed tools to the shed, and cover beds with leaf mulch or cardboard.
items.query: What steps make up the routine for shutting down our patches during the cold months?
